vignette.name: Jam Package Overview
vignette.p: The jam package is a collection of objects focused on working with DMX and ILDA devices.
The package includes two objects to control DMX devices using the ENTTEC DMX USB PRO interface.

ul.li: jam.dmxusbpro - Connect to the ENTTEC DMX USB Pro interface. Conrol DMX data with lists.
jam.dmxusbpro~ - Connect to the ENTTEC DMX USB Pro interface. Conrol DMX data with signals.

vignette.h2: Max Object For Working With Laser Projectors
vignette.p: In addition the package contains a set of object to laser control laser projectors (equipped with an ILDA interface) and to work with ILDA files (laser animations).

ul.li: jam.helios -Connect to a Helios ILDA DAC
jam.ilda.compose - Create and mofify ILDA files for laser animation.
jam.ilda.dict - Create a dictionary from an ILDA file with file information.
jam.ilda.file - Load an ILDA file (laser animation file) from disk.
jam.jit.gl.ilda.sketch - Render frames from an ILDA file to an Open GL context.
